sources.snippet: The UTD approach, which dynamically triggers self-correction based on average uncertainty over recent tokens, is quite interesting. The method shows good parameter-efficiency and strong results in improving accuracy, with 8B model trained on the dataset closing the gap on factuality and reasoning against a 70B baseline.

sources.title: Self-Correcting AI Agents: How to Build AI That Learns From Its ...
sources.snippet: A self-correcting agent is an AI system that can recognize its own failures and attempt a new strategy. If the initial approach doesn't work, the agent re-evaluates and tries an alternative path.
